summary:
The model part of the `due` change is done and its 44 tests pass. I did not touch the rest of the chain, because the rules in this node only allow writes under `src/model/**`.

**Changed (only in `src/model/`):**
- `src/model/todo.ts`
  - `Todo` gets an optional `due?: string`. The field is only present when a due date was given, so existing `todos.json` data stays valid.
  - `addTodo(state, title, due?)` accepts an optional due date. If one is passed, it is validated, and an invalid one throws `截止日期无效`. Calls without `due` behave as before.
  - New `parseDue(input)`: accepts only a real calen
